title: Generative-AI-discovered TNIK inhibitor rentosertib shows FVC improvement in a 71-patient phase 2a IPF trial
summary: Phase 2a GENESIS-IPF trial in China: 60 mg daily rentosertib +98.4 mL FVC vs -20.3 mL placebo at 12 weeks; cohort-level, sponsor-run
account: Rentosertib, a TNIK inhibitor designed with Insilico Medicine's generative-AI platform, was tested in a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2a trial (NCT05938920) in 71 patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis conducted at 21 sites in China from 19 July 2023 to 11 June 2024 (paper); the registry lists 22 locations, a start date of 19 June 2023 and study completion on 8 August 2024. The primary endpoint was safety; treatment-emergent adverse events were similar across arms. Patients on 60 mg once daily showed a mean forced vital capacity change of +98.4 mL versus -20.3 mL on placebo over 12 weeks. Insilico sponsored the trial; eleven authors are its employees and the first author is at Peking Union Medical College Hospital. Results appeared in Nature Medicine on 3 June 2025; the authors call for larger, longer trials.
purpose: Rentosertib was designed as an antifibrotic treatment for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis; the trial tested the safety and preliminary efficacy of exactly that intended benefit.
system: Insilico Medicine generative-AI drug discovery platform (target discovery and generative chemistry) that produced rentosertib (ISM001-055)
deployer: Insilico Medicine (trial sponsor) with 21 clinical centers in China
taxonomy_note: The benefit is a new drug candidate and trial evidence rather than an individual outcome; knowledge discovery is the closest category.

ratings.reason: General benefit without an event: the FVC improvement is a cohort mean from a 71-patient, 12-week, sponsor-run phase 2a trial with safety as the primary endpoint; cohort-level evidence is not placed on the scale.
General benefit without an event: any wider benefit depends on confirmation in larger, longer trials, which the authors themselves say are warranted; cohort-level evidence is not placed on the scale.

ai_role.statement: The AI role is upstream: generative-AI tools identified TNIK as a target and designed the molecule; any clinical effect is pharmacological. The trial was not powered for efficacy and FVC was not the primary endpoint. An independent network meta-analysis ranks rentosertib favourably on FVC decline but reports a non-significant trend toward more serious adverse events.
